ideas.title: Following the Money: Uncovering the Extent of Minnesota Fraud
ideas.description: Investigate the scope and scale of fraud in Minnesota, including child care and Medicaid fraud
questions: What is the total amount of fraud in Minnesota?
How are federal programs being exploited?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to expose widespread fraud and corruption in Minnesota, and to highlight the need for increased oversight and scrutiny of federal programs
